name: Exterior Garage Door Finish Coat 1
intent: Finish coat 1 with leapfrog technique for sectional doors. Brush, spray, or spray_backbrush.
doctrine: Garage door finish coat 1. Leapfrog technique: articulate door to expose panel edges, paint edges, close, paint face. Door size and panel complexity modifiers apply. No roll (introduces orange peel on metal).
